title: I Ghosted 50 Networking Events. Here's What Happened Instead.
script: I ghosted 50 networking events. Here's what happened. I showed up, handed out business cards, said 'Let's connect,' and nothing came of it. 50 events, zero meaningful relationships. So I stopped going to events and replaced them with three things that actually work. One: personalized DMs to three people per week — one genuine question about their work, one specific observation. Two: one piece of content per week about what I actually know. Let it attract the right people automatically. Three: one monthly virtual coffee with someone from step one. Quality beats quantity every time. Stop going to events. Start building actual relationships.
